articles.title: NSE signs MoU with Bharat Metal Exchange to boost non-ferrous metal derivatives market
articles.content: NSE has signed an MoU with Bharat Metal Exchange to promote non-ferrous metal derivatives in India, aiming to strengthen price risk management and market participation. The collaboration will combine NSE’s derivatives infrastructure with BME’s industry expertise to expand hedging tools and deepen awareness across the metals value chain.

articles.title: India, Taiwan ETFs see record outflows before Asia stock rebound
articles.content: US-listed ETFs tracking India and Taiwan saw record outflows in March amid currency weakness, rising yields and energy concerns. Despite this, Asian equities rebounded sharply on hopes of easing geopolitical tensions. Analysts warn sentiment remains fragile, with India’s underperformance and Taiwan’s energy-linked risks still weighing on investor outlook.

articles.title: European shares muted as investors weigh U.S.-Iran talks
articles.content: European markets showed little movement as investors weighed U.S.-Iran talks for progress on Strait of Hormuz shipping. articles.title: Bitcoin stabilises near $64,000 as long-term holders continue accumulation despite ETF inflow pause
articles.content: Bitcoin held near the $64,000 level on Monday, with mixed short-term price signals as long-term holders accumulated despite weak ETF inflows. Analysts noted short-term volatility, ongoing macro uncertainty, and cautious institutional flows even as selective accumulation supported price stability.

articles.title: Tata Capital shares slip 3% after stock rallies 17% in one week to lifetime high. What’s ahead?
articles.content: Tata Capital shares saw a dip on Monday following a significant rally that propelled them to an all-time high last week. articles.title: Cipla shares jump 4% as Citi puts stock on 90-day catalyst watch. What's driving the optimism?
articles.content: Cipla's stock surged following Citi's 'Buy' rating and a 90-day Positive Catalyst Watch. articles.title: Advit Jewels IPO opens tomorrow: GMP at 47%; SBI Securities recommends 'Subscribe'
articles.content: Jaipur's handcrafted jewellery maker, Advit Jewels, is set to launch its IPO on June 23, 2026, with strong grey market interest indicating a potential listing premium. The Rs 165.16 crore issue aims to strengthen the balance sheet, fund working capital, and repay debt. Specializing in Kundan and Polki under the Rambhajo brand, the company boasts a heritage of craftsmanship and a fully integrated manufacturing facility.

articles.title: Vikram Solar shares fall 3% after NCLT admits insolvency petition against the company. Here's why
articles.content: Vikram Solar shares declined after the NCLT admitted an insolvency petition filed by Isitva Steels over alleged dues linked to civil works for a solar EPC project. articles.title: SK Hynix overtakes Samsung to become South Korea's most valuable company
articles.content: SK Hynix has surged past Samsung Electronics to become South Korea's most valuable company, driven by its dominance in high-bandwidth memory (HBM) chips crucial for AI systems. This remarkable turnaround, from near collapse two decades ago to a market leader, highlights the transformative impact of the AI boom on the semiconductor industry. The chipmaker's strategic focus on specialized HBM has propelled its shares to unprecedented heights.

articles.title: Ceasefire, Inflation, Elections: 5 themes driving global markets this week
India bonds walk tightrope on steady oil, shaky US-Iran truce
articles.content: Indian government bonds traded cautiously early Monday, as concerns over U.S.-Iran tensions tempered relief from falling oil prices. While oil's dip below $80 a barrel eases import costs, traders remain wary of El Nino's impact on inflation and global yield risks. Markets are also awaiting a key decision on India's inclusion in a major global bond index, which could boost foreign investment.
